en.question: I have activated <<10411>>'s『target 1 Set card your opponent controls; return that target to the bottom of the Deck』effect by targeting a Set monster in my opponent's Monster Zone. However, in response, <<4956>> resolves, flipping the targeted monster face-up. As a result, the monster is no longer Set by the time <<10411>>'s effect resolves. What happens to it?
en.title: If the target of <<10411>>'s effect is face-up when its effect resolves, will it be returned to the bottom of the Deck?
